name: Operating Margin
description: Calculate operating margin as a percentage of revenue.
business_contexts: a retailer assessing operating margin after COGS and operating expenses
a manufacturer assessing operating margin on total revenue
a software company assessing operating margin after SG&A
a restaurant chain assessing operating margin across locations
a distributor assessing operating margin on total shipments
question_patterns: Given the revenue, COGS, and operating expenses below, what is the operating margin?
Calculate operating margin as a percentage of revenue from the figures given.
What percentage of revenue is operating profit, given the values below?
Calculate the operating margin from the revenue, COGS, and operating expenses shown.
Using the figures given, what is the operating margin?
solution_logic: Step 1: Calculate gross profit = revenue − cogs
Step 2: Calculate operating profit = gross profit − operating_expenses
Step 3: Calculate operating margin = operating profit / revenue
key_insight: Operating margin is operating profit converted into a percentage of revenue, making core operating performance comparable across companies of different sizes.
common_mistakes: Dividing operating profit by cost instead of revenue
Reporting gross margin instead of continuing through to operating margin
framework_soundbite: Operating margin is operating profit over revenue — core earning power as a percentage.
